Q2198 bank0: row 9 reader 479->404ns, total 944->863-875; rows 0-8 flat; writes row-independent. Q2227 L1: (0,0)/(0,9) 632-638, other cores 853 -> keep default for L1

Per-core: reader 400ns iff core in the NoC0-optimal row of its bank (any x), else 480. Writes show no row effect. Launch skew st up to 77ns at x=0. noc0 placement (x=0/7 columns) was slower on Q2216 - testing column-spread variant
spread0 beats default on all 12 DRAM cells (-2.6..-10%), cm control flat/worse, guards Q2185/P39 flat, L1 Q2227 flat. noc0 better at 49/64 tiles (F320 1581 vs spread0 1693). Investigating per-core

rule (spread0<=4/bank, noc0 above, L1 default) wins 3-12% on all DRAM cells with tiles<110; full-grid small cells regress (Q2188 +10%, Q2219 +8%, Q2187 +4.5%, Q2209 +3.5%), Q2185/P39 flat. Rechecking regressions once

Full-grid regressions confirmed (Q2188 2941 vs 2722, Q2219 3109 vs 2837, Q2187 7728 vs 7488, Q2209 2620 vs 2539). Final rule: DRAM and tiles<cores -> bank-row placement; else default. Verdict WIN on all 13 sub-grid DRAM cells.
